source_text.body:
Research companies and fill a CRM from a lead list
ChatGPT Agent Mode researches each company on LinkedIn and websites, logs the data into a CRM and fills missing fields, which the host says is faster than Operator.
Done with
GA
ChatGPT Agent
OP
Operator
What they did
On the Everyday AI podcast, Jordan Wilson lists CRM enrichment as a use case but doesn't demo it. He describes giving agent mode a lead list. It would research each company on LinkedIn and websites, type the data into a CRM, and fill missing fields with current data. His live demo was podcast analytics, where he took over the browser to log in first.
How it went
He says this could turn weeks of manual data entry into hours. No CRM run or results are shown. His live demo hit bugs and needed retries, and the agent is slow.
Worth knowing
Check privacy and security rules before logging the agent into a CRM, and start with a small task you can watch rather than your key accounts.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Here is my lead list: [paste company names or a spreadsheet link]. For each company, research its website and LinkedIn page and collect [fields, e.g. industry, headcount, HQ location, key contacts, recent news]. Then fill in the matching fields in my CRM at [CRM link] and mark any value you could not verify. Do the first 3 and show me before continuing, and don't send emails or overwrite existing data without asking.
Original source: https://www.youreverydayai.com/chatgpt-agent-mode-overview-real-use-cases-and-3-worthwhile-tips/
